2.5.7.1 MCAL Multi-Core Module Type I
The MCAL modules are available on a single core only, the interfaces are not globally
available.
Type I = 1a + 2a + 3a
The type is defined as a single-core module providing its service API’s to one core only
and implementing the kernel on exactly this core as the according HW elements shall
be accessed by one core only.
Figure 2.8: Type I
Examples of Type I are FLS, MEMIF and FEE. To limit the scope to this core, an
according SwAddrMethod with local scope can be applied.
